tools.name: get_quote
tools.description: Delayed stock quote with the 30-day implied volatility (IV30), from optionsprofitcalculator.com.

tools.name: get_expirations
tools.description: Option expiry dates listed for a symbol, with days to expiry and number of strikes, from optionsprofitcalculator.com.

tools.name: get_option_chain
tools.description: Calls and puts for one expiry: bid, ask, last, mid, volume, open interest and implied volatility, from optionsprofitcalculator.com.

tools.name: probability_of_profit
tools.description: Probability of profit, breakevens, max profit and max loss for an options position, calculated by optionsprofitcalculator.com (any mix of up to 8 call/put legs and 1 stock leg). Missing prices and IVs are filled from current market data. Probability is at the earliest expiry, from a lognormal model

tools.name: calculate_position
tools.description: Everything probability_of_profit returns, plus the profit/loss graph data the optionsprofitcalculator.com calculator shows: P/L in dollars across a grid of stock prices and dates up to the earliest expiry. Use it to chart a position or to see how profit changes over time. calculatorUrl opens the sam

tools.name: find_options
tools.description: Find the best single options or vertical spreads for a price target by a date, with the optionsprofitcalculator.com option finder, ranked by return on max risk (return on margin for naked short options). Returns up to 5, each with a calculatorUrl.
